title: SafeAAD: mls-rs sends empty authenticated_data in a safe_aad room; hub refuses (EndOfStream). Accept empty as no items?
description: From mimid-64xc (bfa6a2b): mls-rs has no notion of SafeAAD (mls-extensions-11 §4.9) and sends empty authenticated_data; mimi-mls decodes it as SafeAAD and fails, so the hub answers notAllowed. Encoded empty SafeAAD is 0x00. Question: should mimid treat zero-length authenticated_data as a SafeAAD with no items (lenient), or keep strict? Check §4.9 wording; possibly a WG/extensions-draft clarification.
